youtube_description:
*Facepalm!* Just listen to some of the crazy talk coming from these crazy students and science teacher who believe in Creationism and at the same time wear the cross close to their hearts. You'll be amazed (and dumbfounded) at their comments!

The teacher's email is: wilkeyj@rheacounty.org

This is a clip from the BBC1 documentary 'Science Friction: Creation' circa 1996

To watch this portion of the documentary in its entirety:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tsxKav5spAU&feature=related
